content: Farizeu sira husu kona ba feen-laen soe malu
Jesus hanorin hotu tiha, Nia lao sai husi Galileia hodi baa iha provinsia Judeia iha mota Jordaun nia sorin ba.
Ema barak teb-tebes tuir Nia, i Nia kura sira nia moras.
Depois ema balu husi grupu Farizeu mai koko atu hamonu Nia. Sira husu dehan, “Tuir Moisés nia lei, laen soe nia feen ho razaun saida deit, bele ka lae?”
Jesus hataan, “Imi la lee iha Livru Sagradu kona ba Maromak halo ema ka? Iha nebaa hakerek dehan, ‘Nia halo sira mane ho feto.’
I hakerek tan dehan,

content.text: ‘Tanba nee, mane sei husik nia inan-aman
hodi baa moris neon ida laran ida ho nia feen,
i sira nain rua sai ona ida.’

content: Entaun sira laos ona ema nain rua, maibee sai ona ida. Nee duni se Maromak tau feto ho mane hamutuk sai feen-laen ona, ema keta fahe fali.”
Depois ema Farizeu sira nee husu fali ba Jesus, “Se nunee, nusaa mak Moisés dehan, laen bele soe nia feen, naran katak nia foo surat deklarasaun soe malu nian?”
Jesus hataan, “Moisés nia lei foo lisensa atu imi soe imi nia feen tanba imi nia ulun toos. Maibee fo-foun Maromak halo lalehan ho rai laos nunee.

Hau hatete ba imi, mane so bele soe nia feen kuandu nia feen halo ona sala seksual ho ema seluk. Se nia feen la halo sala nee, maibee mane nee soe nia hodi hola fali feto seluk, mane nee halo sala seksual.”
Rona nunee, Jesus nia eskolante sira dehan, “Se hanesan nee, diak liu lalika kaben.”
Jesus hataan, “Laos ema hotu-hotu mak bele simu liafuan nee. So ema nebee Maromak foo kbiit ba sira mak bele simu.

Iha ema balu la kaben tanba moris mai sira la bele duni. Iha ema balu la kaben tanba ema seluk mak halo sira nunee. Iha mos ema balu la kaben tanba sira hakarak foo aan tomak atu serbi Maromak nudar Liurai. See mak bele simu liafuan nee, simu ba.”
Nai Jesus foo bensaun ba labarik
Depois ema balu mai lori labarik ba Jesus atu Nia tau liman ba sira hodi husu Maromak foo bensaun ba sira. Maibee Jesus nia eskolante sira bandu.
Entaun Jesus siak Nia eskolante sira dehan, “Husik labarik sira nee mai iha Hau, la bele bandu. Tanba ema hanesan labarik sira nee mak sai Maromak nia reinu.”
Nia tau liman ba labarik sira nee, depois Nia sai husi nebaa.
Ema riku nebee hakarak tama lalehan
Iha loron ida, iha mane joven ida mai husu Jesus dehan, “Mestri, hau tenki halo buat diak saida para hau bele hetan moris rohan-laek?”
Jesus hataan dehan, “Nusaa mak ita husu mai Hau kona ba saida mak diak? So Maromak deit mak diak. Se ita hakarak hetan moris rohan-laek, halo tuir Nia ukun fuan.”
Joven nee husu fali, “Ukun fuan nebee?” Jesus hataan, “La bele oho ema, la bele halo sala ho ema nia kaben, la bele naok, la bele foo sasin falsu,
respeita o nia inan-aman, i hadomi o nia maluk hanesan o hadomi o nia aan rasik.”
Joven nee hataan dehan, “Ukun fuan sira nee hau halo tuir hotu ona. Saida mak sei falta?”

Jesus hataan, “Se ita hakarak moris kompletu, entaun baa faan tiha ita nia riku-soin hotu, i osan nee fahe ba ema kiak. Nunee mak ita sei hetan fali riku-soin iha lalehan. Fahe hotu tiha, mai tuir Hau.”
Bainhira joven nee rona nunee, nia fila ho laran susar tanba nia riku teb-tebes.
Depois Jesus dehan ba Nia eskolante sira, “Hau hatete lo-loos ba imi, susar teb-tebes ema riku ida atu sai Maromak nia reinu.
Dala ida tan Hau dehan ba imi, kuda kamelu tama liu husi daun kuak susar teb-tebes. Maibee susar liu tan, ema riku ida atu sai Maromak nia reinu hodi hakruuk ba Nia nudar Liurai.”
Bainhira Jesus nia eskolante sira rona nunee, sira admira teb-tebes hodi husu, “Se nunee, see loos mak sei hetan salvasaun?”
Jesus hateke ba sira hodi dehan, “Ba ema, la bele duni. Maibee ba Maromak, buat hotu-hotu bele.”
Depois Pedro dehan, “Ami husik tiha ona buat hotu-hotu hodi tuir Ita Boot. Entaun ami sei hetan saida?”

Jesus hatete ba sira, “Hau dehan lo-loos ba imi, iha mundu foun Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan sei tuur iha kadeira ukun, i naroman lalehan nian haleu hela Hau. Imi sira nebee agora tuir Hau, imi mos sei tuur iha kadeira ukun sanulu resin rua hodi ukun Israel nia suku sanulu resin rua hotu.
See mak husik ona nia uma, nia maun-alin, nia inan-aman, nia oan sira ka nia toos tanba nia tuir Hau, ema nee sei simu fali dala atus ida i sei hetan moris rohan-laek.
Maibee ema barak nebee agora boot sei sai kiik. I ema barak nebee agora kiik sei sai boot.”
